#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 100000000;

struct Node {
    Node *left, *right;
    int minVal;
    bool dirty;
    int setVal;

    Node() : left(nullptr), right(nullptr), minVal(INF), dirty(false), setVal(0) {}

    static void setRange(int f, int t, int l, int r, int val, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return;
        if (f <= l && r <= t) {
            node->setValue(val);
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        setRange(f, t, l, m, val, node->left);
        setRange(f, t, m + 1, r, val, node->right);
        node->update();
    }

    static Node* create(int l, int r) {
        Node* node = new Node();
        if (l != r) {
            int m = (l + r) >> 1;
            node->left = create(l, m);
            node->right = create(m + 1, r);
        }
        node->minVal = INF;
        return node;
    }

    static int queryRange(int f, int t, int l, int r, Node* node) {
        if (f > r || t < l) return INF;
        if (f <= l && r <= t) return node->minVal;
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        return std::min(queryRange(f, t, l, m, node->left), queryRange(f, t, m + 1, r, node->right));
    }

    static void fillFromArray(int l, int r, int* data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            node->minVal = data[l];
            return;
        }
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fillFromArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fillFromArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
        node->update();
    }

    static void fillToArray(int l, int r, int* data, Node* node) {
        if (l == r) {
            data[l] = node->minVal;
            return;
        }
        node->pushDown();
        int m = (l + r) >> 1;
        fillToArray(l, m, data, node->left);
        fillToArray(m + 1, r, data, node->right);
    }

    void update() {
        this->minVal = std::min(left->minVal, right->minVal);
    }

    void setValue(int val) {
        this->minVal = val;
        this->setVal = val;
        this->dirty = true;
    }

    void pushDown() {
        if (dirty) {
            left->setValue(setVal);
            right->setValue(setVal);
            dirty = false;
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;

    vector<vector<int>> intervals(k + 2, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        cin >> intervals[i][0] >> intervals[i][1];
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;

    k++;
    Node* dp[2];
    dp[0] = Node::create(0, n);
    dp[1] = Node::create(0, n);

    int* temp = new int[n + 1];

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        Node* currentDP = dp[i & 1];
        Node* prevDP = dp[(i - 1) & 1];

        int* interval = &intervals[i][0];
        int intervalLen = interval[1] - interval[0];
        int middleLen = interval[0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        Node::fillToArray(0, n, temp, prevDP);
        int copyStart = 0;
        int copyEnd = std::min(n, intervalLen + middleLen);
        int fillStart = copyEnd;
        int fillEnd = n + 1;
        std::copy(temp + copyStart, temp + copyEnd, temp + fillStart);
        std::fill(temp, temp + std::min(n + 1, intervalLen + middleLen), INF);

        int minX = interval[1] - middleLen - intervalLen;
        int maxX = interval[1] - middleLen;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int need = Node::queryRange(minX - j, maxX - j, 0, n, prevDP);
            temp[j] = std::min(temp[j], need + 1);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int need = Node::queryRange(j - middleLen - intervalLen, j - middleLen, 0, n, prevDP);
            temp[j] = std::min(temp[j], need + 2);
        }

        Node::fillFromArray(0, n, temp, currentDP);
    }

    int answer = Node::queryRange(n, n, 0, n, dp[k & 1]);
    if (answer < INF) {
        cout << "Full\n" << answer << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Hungry\n";
    }

    delete[] temp;
    // Free allocated nodes (not shown for brevity, but in production code, you'd implement proper cleanup)
    return 0;
}
